description: issue #685 (slice I6): `on_click` takes no argument (spec/interaction-events.md §Profile grammar: `on_click` takes none). A stray word where the block should be is not a block opener, so the reader reports a parse `ol-missing-end` pointed at the `on_click` head rather than silently accepting an argument. Because the parse fails, `execute()` bails before running anything, so no events are emitted and nothing is registered.

params.hint: wrap the body in [ ] or close it with end.

diagnostics.message: on_click needs a body. wrap the body in [ ] or close it with end.
each instruction needs a new line of its own. i didn't expect [ to keep going on this line.
